hooks.name: container_opened
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge's PlayerContainerEvent.Open fires after the menu is open and is not cancellable)

rust_summary: a player opening one of the game's menus, cancellable (`native_container_opened`).
doc_summary: a player opening one of the game's own menus: `native_container_opened(player, name, kind, pos, cancel)` is heard when a chest, furnace, crafting table, villager, anvil, lectern, horse inventory... is about to open (the job of NeoForge's `PlayerContainerEvent.Open`, but before the menu opens), after the checks that refuse it, with the menu type and the block's position, on a server, with the player's state swapped in. A mod sets `cancel` and nothing opens. Menus a mod opens (`native_open_menu`) are not heard. Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:native_container_opened@`.
